comments.comment: Accountability Comment... I want to do this everyday until 31 December 2020 | we'll see how much I fail and how much I succeed. ✅ Day 1 (7/11/20):  Pretty intense, my whole body was shaking from the first move. but I think the worst pain I feel is not on my abs but on my arms...  ✅ Day 2 (8/11/20) : my whole body still hurts from yesterday, I considered to skip a day, but I did it anyway. my body is not shaking as much as yesterday. The hardest move for me is the mountain climber and ins and out. it's really heavy on  my arms.  ✅ Day 3 (9/11/20) : My body still hurts but I get used to it now. I hear a loser voice at the back of my head persuading me to just skip it today. But writing this accountability comment really helps. It pushes me to just do it. My arms still need to take 3 quick rest in the middle of "climbing the mountain" move.  ✅ Day 4 (10/11/20) :  I really didn't want to do this today. I procrastinated this until night but at the end of the day I remember if I lose to my laziness, things not gonna change. Those 6 packs abs not gonna show up by it self! I'm glad that I did it.  ✅ Day 5 (11/11/20) : I eliminated my loser voice by doing this workout the first thing in the morning. I can easily spend 15 min in the bed checking on my phone right after I wake up and it has became a habit ( maybe you do the same?). Now I'll replace it with 9 min light workout. Today I just need to take 1 quick rest in the middle of "climbing the mountain" instead of 3. yay!  ✅ Day 6 (12/11/20) : Did it in the morning! and I didn't take any quick rest in the middle of "climbing the mountain" I'm surprised. Also I didn't feel any pain from yesterday workout anymore. Is this normal?  ✅ Day 7 (13/11/20) : I can't believe it's already 1 week! time flies so fast. Now that I do this first thing in the morning, I don't hear my loser voice anymore. Right now I'm more motivated to finish the challenge and starting to get used to do workout in the morning. Hopefully this morning routine will build my strength to do harder abs workout on the menu.  ✅ Day 8 (14/11/20) : Weekend, Woke up  late. Meaning : I didn't my morning routine and pushing to do this until the night. The more I procrastinate the harder it become. But I did it. Today I needed to take 3 quick rest in the middle of "climbing the mountain". Maybe I need a rest? hmm we'll see  ✅ Day 9 (15/11/20) : Sunday! manage to do it in the morning. I think did "climbing the mountain" with more intensity thus I needed 3 quick breaks in the middle of it.  ✅ Day 10 (16/11/20) : Did in at 11.30  :/   ✅ Day 11 (17/11/20) : Didn't have time to do it in the morning, so I did it after work  ✅ Day 12 (18/11/20) : It's getting tough to get motivated. Im not as fired up as the first week. Building a habit is the way to do it. Did this in the morning, and I think I gonna need to look for additional abs workout.  ❌ Day 13 (19/11/20) : Woke up late , work till late didn't do it because my loser voice win.  ❌ Day 14 (20/11/20) : Didn't do it. once again my loser voice win. But maybe it's good to have a rest day. although... this was just a loser justification since I've said that I gonna do this everyday.  ✅ Day 15 (21/11/20) : Weekend! did it in the morning. now I gonna need to push my self to wake up early and really do this first thing in the morning. Because When it's done it's done!  ✅ Day 16 (22/11/20) : Did it in the afternoon...! I'm trying to increase the intensity today  ✅ Day 17 (23/11/20) : Did it in the morning...! Gosh it doesn't get easier yet... the mountain climb is still the hardest and now that I increased the intensity , it really makes me out of breath haha..  ✅ Day 18 (24/11/20) : Did it in the night at 11:30 . Today I feel stronger than the other days!  I guess I start to get result!!  ❌ Day 19 (25/11/20): Preoccupied with other things.  ❌ Day 20 (26/11/20): Preoccupied with other things.  ✅ Day 21 (27/11/20) : did this in the morning. Although I almost wanted to abandon this because I didn't do it the last two days, I will just continue to write my journey here.  ❌ Day 22 (28/11/20): Preoccupied with other things. ❌ Day 23 (29/11/20): Preoccupied with other things. ❌ Day 24 (30/11/20): Preoccupied with other things. ❌ Day 25 (1/12/20): Preoccupied with other things.  ✅ Day 26 (2/12/20) : Get back up doing this after a while. Let's go. I can see the result of my progress so far, my abs is harder and looks more defined... definitely gonna continue doing this til the end of the year.
